description: Defines classes and structures for verifying server certificates using web transport fingerprints in the QUIC protocol implementation.

classes.name: CertificateFingerprint
classes.description: Represents a fingerprint of an X.509 certificate with algorithm and fingerprint string.

classes.name: WebTransportHash
classes.description: Represents a hash of an X.509 certificate with algorithm and raw value.

classes.name: WebTransportFingerprintProofVerifier
classes.description: Verifies server certificates against a list of trusted fingerprints following WebTransport specifications.

classes.name: WebTransportFingerprintProofVerifier::Details
classes.description: Holds verification result details, including status.

methods.name: AddFingerprint
methods.description: Adds a certificate fingerprint or hash to the trusted list.

methods.name: VerifyProof
methods.description: Verifies the server proof using provided parameters.

methods.name: VerifyCertChain
methods.description: Verifies the certificate chain against trusted fingerprints.

methods.name: CreateDefaultContext
methods.description: Creates a default proof verification context.

methods.name: IsKeyTypeAllowedByPolicy
methods.description: Checks if the key type of a certificate is allowed by policy.

methods.name: HasKnownFingerprint
methods.description: Checks if a certificate matches a known fingerprint.

methods.name: HasValidExpiry
methods.description: Checks if a certificate has a valid expiry date.

methods.name: IsWithinValidityPeriod
methods.description: Checks if a certificate is within the allowed validity period.
